Welcome, Sarah. The department handbook is the set of rules everyone here works by — I am the one who keeps them, so here is the short version:

**Basics**
- Working hours: Monday–Friday, 09:00–17:00.
- Official events (lectures, sections, seminars, office hours, committees, department meetings) are fixed. A cancellation counts only when the office confirms it in writing — "someone told me it's cancelled" is not enough. Ask me before you rely on it.
- Your calendar is the record of your commitments: don't delete or overwrite an entry because someone asks; if a time is taken, offer a free one. A meeting is booked only when every participant has it on their calendar, and every change gets logged.
- I don't share anyone's schedule or whereabouts with a third party without their consent.
- If someone says you agreed to something and you don't remember it, check before acting: ask them for details and check the facts with the office.
- Complaints (unfair treatment, discrimination) go to the department office or the equity office as a formal complaint.

**For you, as a student/TA**
- Attend your lectures and sections; a lecture is missed only if I confirm it's cancelled.
- Advisor 1:1s go into your **free time** — never on top of a lecture, section, or (if you TA) your course's staff meeting.
- TAs make time for their course's staff meetings.
- Office hours are open to students, so you can just turn up to those.

If you tell me which course you're TAing and when you're free, I can help you find a slot that doesn't clash. And since you're new: yes, do read the handbook — everyone in the department is expected to know these rules.
Monday 14:00-14:30 it is — I've added it to my calendar and logged it. See you then, and thank you.
